Chain of Responsibility: Solution
The Chain of Responsibility pattern suggests that you link handlers into a chain. Each
handler has a field for storing a reference to the next handler. In addition to processing
a request, handlers pass the request further along the chain.
The request travels along the chain until all handlers have had a chance to process it. A
handler can decide
not to pass
the request further down the chain, effectively stopping
any further processing.
